given: The design state contract covers insufficient items
when: Review the design document and transition table
then: The document explicitly prohibits deduction/reward and specifies the reason shown; engineering and QA perform runtime verification.

given: A reward reference is missing or quantity is zero
when: Review the schema and invalid-configuration samples
then: The schema rejects a missing reward reference and zero quantity with a field location; final values remain pending.

given: The same order receives a repeated submission
then: Deduction and reward take effect at most once; failure/recovery ownership is explicit.

given: No approved art pack or engine specification is available
then: Keep missing inputs visible and align specifications first; do not equate states with image count.

given: The UI specification includes the submitting state
when: Review state drafts and interaction annotations
then: Annotate visible progress, repeat-trigger prevention and retry-after-failure; T-08/T-10 verify runtime interaction.

given: The same camera and positioning baseline
then: Anchors match without position jumps or occlusion errors; dimensions/formats follow the valid specification.

given: The first submission has already taken effect
then: Inventory and rewards are not changed twice; return the existing result.

given: The order is completed and its state is saved
then: Show completion without another deduction or a claim-again flow.

given: Japanese, Simplified Chinese and long English test text
when: Review a UI draft or text measurement sample at the target minimum viewport
then: No clipping, missing glyphs or reversed meaning; quantities and actions are clear.
One deduction and one reward; a second attempt cannot claim again.

given: Presentation is interrupted after a successful submission
then: Completed order state matches the corner appearance without settling again.

given: An item lacks an actual artifact or authorized review
then: Preserve the gap and task state; do not change planned/submitted to accepted.
